name: ProvenExpert

sources.title: ProvenExpert homepage — 'register a free ProvenExpert account', aggregated review profile
ProvenExpert registration page (JS-rendered; returns minimal HTML)

requirements: A business or service provider — ProvenExpert aggregates customer reviews (Google, Facebook, and its own surveys) into one public profile
Registration is by email address from the homepage form
preparation: Business email for the free account
Company profile info: name, industry, logo, description
A plan to collect real customer reviews — the profile is populated by reviews and survey responses, not self-written content
workflow: Enter your email in the registration form on provenexpert.com/en-us/ ('register a free ProvenExpert account')
Complete the JS signup flow at /en-us/register/
Send customer surveys / import existing reviews from connected platforms
Verify the public ProvenExpert profile page renders with your rating
watchFor: The register page is JS-rendered — headless fetches return a nearly empty document
Free vs paid plan feature split is not documented on the fetched pages (a Pricing nav item exists); review seals/widgets may be gated
ProvenExpert claims reviews are not algorithmically blocked — but fabricated self-reviews would still violate terms
countsAsLive: A public ProvenExpert profile page for the company showing aggregate rating/review count, reachable without login
unknowns: Free-plan feature limits (the pricing page was not fetched in detail)
Whether free profiles are publicly indexed or require paid tier for SEO visibility
Whether profile links to the company site are dofollow
